items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Lithium price up ~67% y/y but well below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowers lithium company targets following recent spot price weakness, keeps Outperform on Albemarle; group viewed as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle (NYSE:ALB): Is the Lithium Cycle Turning? - Kalkine Media
items.snippet: Lithium pricing and energy storage demand shape the Albemarle conversation.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand up 45% through May on stationary storage; inventories near record lows; supply lagging demand.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares down 29.1% in six months as lithium prices pulled back on softer China EV demand and added supply.
